brief.aim: This is a transactional retail log with no plausible outcome column: the evident purpose is segmenting anonymous customers from their purchase behaviour, so rows (invoice lines) should be rolled up per CustomerID into recency/frequency/monetary-style features and clustered; InvoiceDate is used only to derive recency relative to an observation date, not as a partition time column, and InvoiceNo/StockCode are record-level keys.
brief.repeated_subjects: Each CustomerID recurs across thousands of invoice line items, so all rows for a customer must be aggregated into a single profile and kept in one fold.
brief.unit: customer (one aggregated profile per CustomerID, built from invoice line items)
